svg.title: PitDivers final four-motor wiring
svg.desc: Final FNK0082 GPIO and wiring plan for camera, SD, three sensors, a 74HC595, two L293D drivers and four motors.
svg.text: FNK0082 • camera + SD • DHT11 + HC-SR04 + MPU6050 • 74HC595 • 2 × L293D • 4 motors
Direction uses the 74HC595. GPIO19 controls both left enables; GPIO20 controls both right enables. All GND connections join.
Pin 1 is upper left beside the notch; pin 16 is upper right.
Pin 1 is beside the notch at upper left. Count down to pin 8,
then continue at pin 9 on lower right and count upward to pin 16.
ECHO must pass through divider below
SIOD4 • SIOC5 • VSYNC6 • HREF7 • PCLK13 • XCLK15
CMD38 • CLK39 • DATA0 40 — no external jumpers
Swap both leads of any motor that spins in the wrong physical direction.
4 × AA ≈ 6 V → switch → both L293D pin 8
USB-UART powers ESP32; ESP32 5V → both pin 16
Common GND joins battery negative, ESP32, sensors and all ICs
• Per L293D: 100 nF on pin 16 and pin 8 to GND
• 100 µF across VMOTOR+ / GND near the drivers
Build the final circuit on the general/perfboard ground bus.
Motor bus: 1 DATA • 2 CLOCK • 48 LATCH • 19 LEFT PWM • 20 RIGHT PWM
Sensors: 21 DHT • 47 TRIG • 14 ECHO • 41 SDA • 42 SCL
Do not join driver outputs. GPIO2/48 may flash onboard LEDs while shifting; disable unrelated LED code.
L293D numbers are physical DIP-16 pins, viewed from above with the notch upward.
